before_hobbies.title: Hiking
before_hobbies.content: I maintain a detailed list of the hikes I’ve finished alongside hikes I would like to complete. Currently, my goal is to visit all 63 national parks in the United States. As of January 2026, I have travelled to 11. I would also like to hike as many popular hikes in America as I can, travel to notable national lands, monuments, etc across the country, and explore famous hiking regions like the Dolomites, Swiss Alps, Pyrenees, Patagonia, and so forth. The sheet I use to track hikes can be found here. You can view my AllTrails here.

before_hobbies.title: Mile High Freedom Band
before_hobbies.content: I joined Mile High Freedom Band (MHFB) in August 2025 as a member of the Alto Saxophone section. MHFB is Denver’s LGBTQ+ and ally community music organization formed in 1984. Through the Mile High Freedom Band, I have received the opportunity to perform halftime at Ball Arena for the Denver Nuggets, the Ellie Caulkins Opera House, as well as parades, theater performances, and everything in between. before_hobbies.title: Piano
before_hobbies.content: I began playing piano in April 2025. I took lessons for the first several months working through Nancy Faber's "Faber All In One Adult Piano Adventures" Book 1. At the conclusion of Book 1, I decided to continue as a self-learner and began the second book in the Adult All in One Series on my first (and only) keyboard: a used Casio PX-160 I bought from Facebook Marketplace. As of 2026, I am continuing to work through Book 2. All-In-One Adult Piano Adventures Book 1 by Faber . | Piano Adventures Level 1 Christmas | Piano Adventures Level 1 Popular | .
